title: Catalog card displays product name and price
preconditions: Store is running at http://localhost:3000 and the catalog page is loaded.
steps: Navigate to /.
Locate the card for the 'phone' product via getByTestId('catalog-phone-card').
Read the text of getByTestId('catalog-phone-name') and getByTestId('catalog-phone-price').
expected: catalog-phone-name shows non-empty product name text and catalog-phone-price shows a price formatted as $X.XX (e.g. $0.00 or higher), both visible on the card.

title: Cart quantity can be increased to the maximum of 10 but not beyond
steps: On /, click getByTestId('catalog-phone-add-button') to add one 'phone' to the cart.
Navigate to /cart and confirm getByTestId('cart-phone-line') is visible with cart-phone-qty showing '1'.
Click getByTestId('cart-phone-increase-button') nine times to reach quantity 10.
Read getByTestId('cart-phone-qty').
Click getByTestId('cart-phone-increase-button') one more time and read cart-phone-qty again.
expected: After nine increases cart-phone-qty shows '10'. After the tenth increase attempt cart-phone-qty still shows '10' — quantity never exceeds 10.

title: Lowercase coupon 'agent10' applies a 10% discount (case-insensitive)
preconditions: Cart has items whose combined unit prices total exactly $100.00 (10000 cents).
steps: Add products to the cart until getByTestId('cart-subtotal') displays '$100.00'.
Enter 'agent10' (all lowercase) into getByTestId('cart-coupon-input').
Click getByTestId('cart-coupon-apply-button').
Read getByTestId('cart-coupon-message') and getByTestId('cart-discount').
Arithmetic: discount = 10% of 10000 cents = 1000 cents = $10.00.
expected: cart-coupon-message shows a success confirmation and cart-discount shows '$10.00', proving the code is accepted case-insensitively at the 10% rate.

title: Subtotal $99.99 (just below threshold) charges $7.99 shipping
preconditions: Cart is empty; no coupon applied.
steps: Add products until getByTestId('cart-subtotal') displays '$99.99' (9999 cents).
Read getByTestId('cart-shipping'), getByTestId('cart-tax'), and getByTestId('cart-total').
Arithmetic: shipping = $7.99 (799 cents) because 9999 < 10000. Tax = 6% of 9999 = 599.94 cents, rounded half up = 600 cents = $6.00. Total = 9999 + 799 + 600 = 11398 cents = $113.98.
expected: cart-shipping shows '$7.99', cart-tax shows '$6.00', and cart-total shows '$113.98'.

title: Subtotal $100.00 (at threshold) grants free shipping
preconditions: Cart is empty; no coupon applied.
steps: Add products until getByTestId('cart-subtotal') displays '$100.00' (10000 cents).
Read getByTestId('cart-shipping'), getByTestId('cart-tax'), and getByTestId('cart-total').
Arithmetic: shipping = $0.00 because 10000 >= 10000. Tax = 6% of 10000 = 600 cents = $6.00. Total = 10000 + 0 + 600 = 10600 cents = $106.00.

title: Tax is 6% of the discounted subtotal (shipping excluded), rounded half up
steps: Add products until getByTestId('cart-subtotal') displays '$100.00'.
Enter 'AGENT10' into getByTestId('cart-coupon-input') and click getByTestId('cart-coupon-apply-button').
Confirm getByTestId('cart-discount') shows '$10.00' (discounted subtotal = 9000 cents = $90.00).
Read getByTestId('cart-tax').
Arithmetic: tax = 6% of 9000 = 540 cents = $5.40. Shipping is not taxed.

title: Total equals subtotal minus discount plus shipping plus tax
steps: Add products until getByTestId('cart-subtotal') displays '$100.00'.
Apply coupon 'AGENT10' via getByTestId('cart-coupon-apply-button').
Read cart-discount ('$10.00'), cart-shipping, cart-tax, and cart-total.
Arithmetic: subtotal 10000 − discount 1000 + shipping 799 (discounted subtotal $90.00 < $100) + tax 540 (6% of 9000) = 10339 cents = $103.39.

title: Generic declined card shows the Stripe decline message
preconditions: Cart has at least one item and the user is on /checkout.
steps: Enter a name into getByTestId('checkout-name-input').
Enter 'e2e-decline-<timestamp>@example.com' into getByTestId('checkout-email-input').
Select the generic decline card by clicking getByTestId('checkout-card-declined').
Click getByTestId('checkout-pay-button').
Read getByTestId('checkout-error-alert').
expected: checkout-error-alert shows the exact text 'Your card was declined.'

title: Successful payment transitions the order to PAID and shows 'Payment received'
preconditions: Cart has at least one item; user is on /checkout with a known total T (cart-total / checkout-total).
steps: Enter a name into getByTestId('checkout-name-input').
Enter 'e2e-paid-<timestamp>@example.com' into getByTestId('checkout-email-input').
Select the success card by clicking getByTestId('checkout-card-visa').
Click getByTestId('checkout-pay-button') and wait for navigation to /orders/<order id>.
Read getByTestId('order-status') and getByTestId('order-total').
expected: order-status shows 'Payment received' and order-total shows the same dollar amount as the checkout total.

title: First PAID order promotes a new customer from LEAD to ACTIVE_CUSTOMER
preconditions: The email used has never placed an order before.
steps: Complete a successful checkout using 'e2e-promote-<timestamp>@example.com' and getByTestId('checkout-card-visa').
Navigate to /crm.
Filter getByTestId('crm-customer-row') by the email text and read getByTestId('crm-customer-status') for that row.
expected: The customer row matching 'e2e-promote-…@example.com' shows crm-customer-status as 'ACTIVE_CUSTOMER'.

title: Pressing Pay multiple times creates exactly one order and one charge
preconditions: Cart has at least one item; user is on /checkout.
steps: Enter 'e2e-idempotent-<timestamp>@example.com' into getByTestId('checkout-email-input') and a name into checkout-name-input.
Select getByTestId('checkout-card-visa').
Rapidly click getByTestId('checkout-pay-button') three or more times before navigation completes.
Wait for the order confirmation page to appear, then navigate to /crm.
Count getByTestId('crm-order-row') rows whose crm-customer-email matches the e2e email used.
expected: Exactly one crm-order-row exists for that email — multiple Pay clicks produce a single order and a single charge.

title: Webhook with missing or invalid Stripe signature is rejected with HTTP 400 and changes no ledger state
preconditions: Note the current count of rows in getByTestId('crm-events-table') on /crm.
steps: Record the current number of getByTestId('crm-event-row') rows on /crm.
POST a Stripe webhook event payload (e.g. payment_intent.succeeded) to http://localhost:3000/api/webhooks/stripe with a missing or invalid Stripe-Signature header.
Observe the HTTP response status.
Reload /crm and count getByTestId('crm-event-row') rows again.
expected: The webhook endpoint returns HTTP 400 and the number of crm-event-row rows on /crm is unchanged — no ledger state was modified.
